overview: Trust should come from inspectable process rather than anecdotes.

chapters.title: Reasonable distrust
chapters.description: The item opens by granting distrust as a reasonable stance.

chapters.title: Anecdotes mislead
chapters.description: The item lists alternate explanations for apparent improvement.
chapters.anchor: Maybe their diet changed. Maybe their sleep changed.

chapters.title: Inspect process
chapters.description: The item shifts the inspection target to process evidence.
chapters.anchor: The paper trail around the medicine is what can be inspected.
